Pico-ITX Outline with I/O Cutout The file /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb is a 100 x 72 mm rectangle at Pico-ITX size, with a few placed components but no I/O cutout and no mounting holes. Use KiCad 10.0.2; run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path). On this machine, the installed KiCad tools are `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/pcbnew`, and `/usr/bin/eeschema`; use the one that matches the board or schematic operation.

Add the Pico-ITX I/O bracket cutout (76 x 7 mm) centered on the +Y edge and add four mounting holes at the Pico-ITX corner positions. Keep every component center at least 3 mm from the cutout interior. Then export the Edge.Cuts layer as a single-page SVG from the finished board. Requirements: 1. The board bounding box must remain 100 mm wide by 72 mm tall, within 0.1 mm. 2. The cutout bottom must be a horizontal Edge.Cuts segment at y = 65 mm, spanning 76 mm within 0.1 mm. 3. The cutout side segments must be vertical at x = 12 mm and x = 88 mm, each 7 mm tall within 0.1 mm. 4. Four mounting holes must be present at (3, 3), (97, 3), (3, 69), and (97, 69), each within 0.1 mm. 5. No component center may fall within 3 mm of the cutout region. Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/edgecuts.svg.
